name: Nyktera Sprite
text: You have bat-like features, an affinity for batkind, and hearing that's second to none. As long as you can hear normally, you can seek to sense undetected creatures in a 60-foot cone instead of the GM choosing an area of 30 feet or less as normal. You also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to locate undetected creatures that you could hear within 30 feet with a Seek action.
